node.statement: Re-derive the high-slab localization inside node 1.3.2. Let A_s = {j : h_j >= s}. For each j in A_s, h_j >= s and a_j^+ >= 0, hence s a_j^+ <= a_j^+ h_j. Summing over A_s gives s * sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ <= sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ h_j. Also every omitted term a_j^+ h_j is nonnegative because a_j^+ >= 0 and h_j >= 0, so sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ h_j <= sum_j a_j^+ h_j.
